== Walkthrough ==
Now that the spider is defeated, it is now gone, hence making you able to proceed. The path that comes next gets you trapped on a ground that is sticky, with the spider approaching to you from behind and then trapping you from its web. Try to wiggle around with the arrow keys to break free, then to move forward. Next, there are three obstacles to face:
#The first obstacle is a pit at the bottom of a downward slope.
#The second obstacle is a boulder blocking your path. You have to push it forward. Once it starts rolling by itself, hop back to avoid the tree that will eventually fall down.
#The third is a large boulder across a spiked pit. What you should do is place yourself slightly nea the center of the boulder so that it can slowly roll forward. When the boulder reaches the end of the pit, the next jump will slide further away from the spider, and break you free of the webs.
{{Walkthrough}}
